QuestInfo.name: The Full Report
QuestInfo.0: Nobunaga's influence over Maple World's monsters should not be so pervasive. This merits further investigation. Perhaps Yukimori can advise you about what to do next.
QuestInfo.1: It would be a good idea to check in with Yamanaka Yukimori in Orbis and share what you've learned. He'll know what to do.
QuestInfo.2: Yukimori told you about similar events occurring in Ludibrium. The Oda clan's reach has gone far since you arrived. Yukimori will report back to Momijigaoka while you go investigate.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 5,530\nCan proceed to the Return Orders quest

0.0: Just as Athena Pierce feared, Nobunaga has allied himself with the nefarious Black Wings...
0.1: What could he be scheming that he would require their power? Perhaps his forces are weaker than I thought.
0.2: The Oda clan was never one to rely on diluting their own power with underhanded deals. It seems unlike him.
0.3: And using dark magic to cause chaos in Maple World... where is the rigid, structured warlord I have battled in the past?
0.4: All this thinking is making me hungry. I'd best return to Momijigaoka... maybe that nice fellow Kenshin will have me over for dinner.

yes.0: Actually, I should stop by Orbis and check on Yukimori. A familiar face might do him well.
